title: Share your training
summary: Share your workouts with other members, choose what else they see, and follow their training.
changes: Turn on Profile sharing in Profile. Your workouts are shared, and sharing is what lets you see other members.
Choose separately whether to add body weight, goals, cardio sessions, notes and your profile photo.
Open Shared profiles to browse other sharing members' workouts and anything else they share.
Stop sharing at any time; your profile and other profiles become private again straight away.

image.alt: A shared profile for a sample member, showing workout totals, a body-weight chart with the goal line, goal progress and weekly Zone 2 cardio progress.
